Wording transcribed verbatim from the study's own Qualtrics printouts, which print each statement immediately followed by its export tag (gmc_xxx_0k_x|r / t2_gmc_xxx_0k_x|r); T1 and T2 wording identical apart from line wrapping and page breaks (T1 item 01 and T2 item 04 span a page footer, removed). Anchors printed as Strongly disagree (-3), Moderately disagree (-2), Slightly disagree (-1), Neither agree nor disagree (0), Slightly agree (1), Moderately agree (2), Strongly agree (3); parenthesised values not shipped. REVERSE KEYING: the authors' Rmd (5a3gc line 369, mutate_at(vars(matches('_r$')), ~.x * -1)) reverses the _r columns BEFORE exporting data_deidentified.csv (line 429), so the deposit's gmc_xxx_03_r and _04_r are already reversed and the live resp for them is (-chosen value)+4. option_text therefore describes what respondents actually chose: for 01/02/05 resp 1..7 = Strongly disagree..Strongly agree; for 03_r/04_r resp 1..7 = Strongly agree..Strongly disagree. Confirmed by sign: stored 03_r/04_r correlate +0.46..+0.67 (T1) and +0.54..+0.77 (T2) with the three forward belief items, impossible for raw 'I feel they are untrue'/'proved to be false'. Every item uses all 7 levels in both waves.
